description: This file defines an asynchronous function to generate instructions for creating and configuring MCP servers, including detailed explanations, code snippets, and procedural steps for setting up local and remote MCP servers, especially for weather data, using the MCP SDK and related tools.

methods.name: createMCPServerInstructions
methods.description: Generates detailed instructions and code snippets for creating and configuring MCP servers, including local and remote server setups, with procedural guidance for setup, coding, building, and deployment.
